reason: A single LOCK TABLE list acquires relations sequentially. Waiting on the first relation does not queue protection on every later relation. Pre/post snapshots and one pre-handoff NOWAIT probe do not prove a gap-free all25 transfer.

primarySources.support: LOCK list relations are acquired sequentially in specified order.
LockTableCommand loops relations and acquires each through RangeVarGetRelidExtended.
